title: save_memory input
description: Proposes a memory note about the code: a decision, gotcha, invariant, domain, glossary entry, capability, or ownership. The note is stored as an agent's proposal and stays unaccepted until a person accepts it; saving again under the same id replaces the proposal.

repository_id.description: Optional when exactly one repository is registered.

snapshot_id.description: Null pins the current published snapshot.

freshness.description: snapshot (default) answers from the published snapshot. strict first checks that the working tree is exactly what the snapshot was built from; if not, it starts an index and refuses with STALE_INPUT naming the changed files.

envelope.description: compact leaves out the snapshot-wide parts of the envelope (unresolved reasons, standing limitations) that an earlier answer from the same snapshot already gave; query-specific limits stay. Over MCP, answers after the first full one per snapshot are compact unless full is asked for.
